授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
This course aims to develop the ability to read and summarize abridged texts on ethical theories, and consider those theories' principles in relation to some real life problems often discussed in the mass media. In this course, students will learn and be tested in their knowledge of both specialized academic and general English vocabulary used in these texts and articles, and will learn how to summarize the contents of these articles. Students will also learn how to gather and critically discuss information on ethical issues important in modern society.
In this course, students will learn to at least write a summary of an important ethical theory idea and its application to an important moral problem, and to discuss these ideas with each other in English.
